text:
Mia: heads up — noticed ~4% of inbound HubSpot leads are getting stuck waiting for enrichment and never entering the sales RR. noticed after the webinar push.
Sam: ugh, that's the jitter we've seen at scale. any common signal? IDs or workflow step?
Mia: looks like enrichment_status = pending for > 10m. HubSpot workflow triggers a hold until enrichment completes, then goes to the round-robin. but enrichment sometimes times out and never flips.
Lee: is the enrichment async webhook to our enrichment service? could be retries/backpressure causing the webhook to drop.
Mia: yes, webhook -> enrichment queue -> callback to HS. enrich-bot logged a couple 504s.
enrich-bot: automated note: 12 enrichment callbacks failed (504) between 16:02-16:10 UTC, retry window exhausted.
Ashley: CS is seeing missed follow-ups. Can we short-circuit: if enrichment pending > 5m, assign to fallback SDR queue with tag "needs-enrich"?
Raj: quick mitigation: set workflow to fallback after 5m and add property enrich_retry_count. permanent fix requires making enrichment callbacks idempotent + retry shim.
Sam: agree on fallback. quick patch I can push: update HS workflow condition from `enrichment_status != \"complete\"` hold -> to use `enrichment_started_at < now() - 5m` then route to fallback. small change in the workflow UI.
Raj: leaving a note — will add guard so fallback only for inbound sources webinar/* and api/* (avoid routing high-value MQLs wrongly).
Mia: can we also add an alert when fallback rate > 1% of leads in a 15m window so ops can triage before CS emails spike?
Lee: yep, will add a Datadog monitor on the HubSpot contact property change events. threshold 1% over 15m.
Ashley: also request a short copy for SDRs explaining what "needs-enrich" means — e.g., "missing enrichment: try quick LinkedIn + intent question". I'll draft.
Sam: temp rollout plan: 1) change workflow to fallback after 5m (today), 2) enable enrich_retry_count property (tomorrow), 3) implement idempotent callback shim (next sprint).
Mia: sounds good. can someone open a GH issue and link to HS workflow id?
Raj: opened ticket RDW-1428 and linked HS workflow 98123. assigning to @sam and @lee.
Sam: i'll push the workflow change at 18:00 UTC (low traffic), will post here when done.
Lee: i'll add the Datadog monitor and a Slack alert to #marketing if fallback > 1%.
Mia: thanks all — please ping if you need a rollback plan. :thumbsup:
Sam: done — workflow patched and smoke-tested. patch note: fallback window = 5m, tag=needs-enrich.
Mia: verified a handful of test leads went to fallback owner, CS was able to follow up. keeping an eye on metrics.
Ashley: drafting SDR note now, will share in 20m.
Raj: leaving this open until idempotent shim shipped. marking thread as reference RDW-1428.
